comments: Registered as one bank on the stone footing line; the pivot x is the centre of the footing. The lit crop has the ajar door eight source pixels below the footing line; a reviewed sub-crop ends it on the line shared with the other two (the door tip is the only thing cut). Painted 47 of 48 px wide.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the weathered timber and the contour brown: the palette snap had sent brown-grey flecks (source about 816145) to an olive ink (69793e) and the dark brown outline (source about 241e1b) to a dark green one (182414); the grade maps those two admitted shared inks to the browns 684629 and 25140b; no pixel is moved, added or removed.
geometry: The footprint, the door tile and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: day-0, night-0, lit-0. The measurer's near-touching warning was checked against the sheet's alpha: the crops are tight and the empty columns 514-521 and 1020-1027 separate them, so none is merged.
